products.description:
Lightweight with a quick-absorbing texture, Aesop’s Protective Facial Lotion provides broad spectrum defence against harmful UVA and UVB rays, while delivering a simultaneous boost of hydration. 
 The mattifying cream combines panthenol with vitamin E to help moisturise the skin. Supported by the soothing properties of green tea, the formula leaves skin feeling nourished, topped with a herbaceous fragrance for a touch of luxury. 
 Vegan.
